page.title: Duel simulator
page.description: Test your combos and play real duels with the actual card effects (EDOPro engine).

engine.downloading: The server is downloading card scripts (a few minutes the first time). This page refreshes on its own.
engine.unavailable: The duel engine is unavailable on this server.

setup.title: New duel
setup.noDecks: Build a deck first to test it here.

opponent.label: Opponent
opponent.PASSIVE_hint: Does nothing: perfect to test combos against a board you set up.
opponent.ME_hint: You make every choice for both players: test interactions, hand traps, lines.
opponent.BOT_hint: Plays the opponent deck on its own: builds its board, attacks when it's worth it and answers your plays with hand traps and traps.

hand.label: Opening hand
hand.hint: Force cards into your starting hand (the rest is drawn at random).

board.label: Opponent board
board.hint: Cards already in place on the opponent's side when the duel starts: monsters, set cards, hand traps, graveyard…
board.empty: No cards: the opponent starts with an empty field.

chains.label: Chains
chains.hint: Auto: you're only asked to chain after an opponent's action (or when it's mandatory). Always: at every chain window, as in EDOPro.

prompt.IDLE: Click a highlighted card to play it, or change phase.
prompt.BATTLE: Choose an attacker, activate an effect or leave the Battle Phase.

CHAIN.title: Activate a card or effect?
CHAIN.forced: You must activate one of these effects.

PLACE.title: Choose a zone on the field
PLACE.disable: Choose a zone that will become unusable

SORT.title: Choose the order
SORT.hint: Click the cards in the order you want (first = top).

prompt.choose: Choose {count, plural, one {# value} other {# values}}
